name: ScriptaHub – Edit book
description: Process reserved edition requests in isolated subflows and reconcile each result.

tasks.name: Reserve batch and select first request
tasks.prompt:
Follow scriptahub-tasks SKILL.md and the operation reference for execution context, native calls, recovery, handoff, source scope and acceptance.

Verify edit-edition is runnable in the supplied child catalogue before reserving or claiming. Run preflight and batch-start with {"taskType":"edit"} once.

Use batch-next. If publicationPending=true, return nextEdgeId=batch-to-reconcile and nextNodePrompt with taskId, executionId, taskDirectory and the pending flag. If task=null, or a prerequisite fails before claim, take batch-to-result with the actual outcome. Close an empty batch when safe.

For a processing item return nextEdgeId=batch-to-book, afterWorkflowsEdgeId=book-to-reconcile and workflow=edit-edition. Include one child prompt with taskId, executionId, taskDirectory, claimedPath and handoffPath. Pass the same compact identity and paths as nextNodePrompt. Continue on child failure so the parent can reconcile the item.

tasks.name: Select next reserved request
tasks.prompt:
Follow scriptahub-tasks SKILL.md and the operation reference for execution context, native calls, recovery, handoff, source scope and acceptance.

Verify edit-edition is runnable. Continue the current reservation snapshot and call only batch-next for selection. Refresh preflight if needed.

Use batch-next. If publicationPending=true, return nextEdgeId=next-to-reconcile and nextNodePrompt with taskId, executionId, taskDirectory and the pending flag. If task=null, or a prerequisite fails before claim, take next-to-result with the actual outcome. Close an empty batch when safe.

For a processing item return nextEdgeId=next-to-book, afterWorkflowsEdgeId=book-to-reconcile and workflow=edit-edition. Include one child prompt with taskId, executionId, taskDirectory, claimedPath and handoffPath. Pass the same compact identity and paths as nextNodePrompt. Continue on child failure so the parent can reconcile the item.

tasks.name: Confirm the edition request result
tasks.prompt:
Follow scriptahub-tasks SKILL.md and the operation reference for execution context, native calls, recovery, handoff, source scope and acceptance.

Use the selected taskId and executionId to check service status. For a selector's already pending publication, reconcile that registered package with retry-publication and keep any uncertain response for deferral. For a child outcome, read its actual error and the task's retained evidence. A completed publication requires service confirmation.

For safe failures before submission, finish with the actual error; acknowledge a confirmed stop with finish state=cancelled when safe. Pending publication, active processing, a failed finish or a still-uncertain item requires batch-defer for this taskId/executionId and the concrete reason. Use the single outgoing edge once terminal or durably deferred. Report unavailable shared service access as the actual blocker.

tasks.name: Summarize edition publications
tasks.prompt:
Follow scriptahub-tasks SKILL.md and the operation reference for execution context, native calls, recovery, handoff, source scope and acceptance.

Call batch-status for the saved snapshot. Report confirmed publications, failures, cancellations and deferred items with reasons. If traversal remains open, use batch-close with retainActive:true only after the remaining active items have been deferred. Finish the batch result without reserving more work.

defaultObjective: Process the fixed batch of eligible edition requests.
